Senior Network / System / Software Engineer Job at Trinity University (TU)




        
    

        
        Trinity University (TU), duly licensed by the Federal Government of Nigeria was promoted by Trinity Education & Development Foundation (TEDF), the owners of Trinity International College, Ofada, Ogun State, a leading secondary school with world-class performance which has consistently represented Nigeria in the International Science Olympiads among other achievements. The University sets out to further pursue the Trinity Vision of combining academic excellence with practical competence and impeccable character.

Applications are invited for the position below:

 Job Position: Senior Network / System / Software Engineer

Job Location: Yaba, Lagos
Unit: ICT

Requirements
     

            
    




	Candidates should possess a relevant qualifications.


Salary
TUNTSS 9.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Detailed Curriculum Vitae, Duly signed Cover Letter, and Scanned copy of certificates to the "Human Resources and Development Unit" via: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Aplications should be addressed to:
The Registrar,
Trinity University,
Yaba, Lagos.

The Curriculum Vitae should contain:


	Full Name (Surname First)
	Date of Birth (Not Age)
	Gender
	Marital Status
	Town / LA / State of Origin
	Contact and Resident Address
	Telephone Number
	Present Position with Date Attained
	Current Salary
	Work Experience (with start and end dates)
	Institution attended with dates and qualification
	Statement and Personal Research Focus
	Publication or Jornals (Local and International)
	Conferences Attended with Dates
	Membership of Lerned societies
	Names and Addresses of Three Referees.


Note


	All documents should be merged in a single PDF.
    

    

        Click here to Apply
